Merged as 2307. The lane executed for the FIRST time post-merge (run 33142294774, the first run whose workflow definition carries the job) and PASSED. Step outcomes:

  success  Prove bwrap can namespace and enforce (fail the lane if not)
  success  Run the sandbox enforcement tests under a real bwrap

The precondition step's success is itself the proof: it is written to fail unless the child RAN and the outside write was DENIED, so it cannot pass on a runner where bwrap merely exists. The test step ran with REBAR_REQUIRE_SANDBOX_ENFORCEMENT=1, under which a missing mechanism fails rather than skips.

Scope limit worth recording: I could not fetch that job's raw log text (the API returned nothing for it), so the CI evidence is step-level conclusions rather than a quoted 'N passed, 0 skipped' line. The identical container command was verified locally against a clean git-archive export: 43 passed, 0 skipped.
